text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- NATO Secretary-General in Skopje on Monday afternoon for talks on NATO expansion with Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov and other top officials.

- "Prime Minister Crvenkovski's speech in parliament in which he announced decisive battle against organised crime in Macedonia deserves support and that is the reason why general demonstrations against the government have been postponed for a month," opposition IMRO-DPMNY leader Ljubco Georgievski says.
- First Red Cross aid from Macedonia consisting of 15 tonnes of flour to be delivered to Albania on Monday.

- The opposition Democratic and Liberal parties demand early elections and forming of expert government, expressing mistrust in the prime minister's intention to deal with organised crime. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201-196
